mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.enabled, dept.enabled AS department_enabled, u.clearance_level AS clearance, d.security_level, TRUE AS can_view, TRUE AS can_review FROM kb_document d JOIN kb_space s ON s.id = d.space_id CROSS JOIN sys_user u JOIN sys_dept dept ON dept.id = u.dept_id WHERE d.id = #{documentId} AND d.status NOT IN ('deleted', 'archived') AND s.archived = FALSE AND u.enabled = TRUE AND dept.enabled = TRUE AND u.clearance_level >= d.security_level AND AND AND u.id <> #{uploaderId} AND u.id <> #{submittedBy} AND u.id = #{userId} ORDER BY u.id
